blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Embodied spatial intelligence requires more than visual recognition: models must localize entities, reason about their relations, and express this knowledge in action-relevant forms. Yet joint training can conflate the knowledge needed at different stages because supervision is fragmented across incompatible geometric and semantic outputs. We introduce Anvil, a unified framework for data generation, training, and benchmarking for embodied spatial intelligence. (1) Anvil-Gen is a heterogeneous data flywheel that combines form-specific generation, cross-stage consistency verification, and failure-driven recollection across 11 Ground--Relation--Act forms. (2) Anvil-Ben provides scene-aligned supervision for learning diverse embodied spatial capabilities and scene-linked assessments that distinguish stage competence from error propagation. (3) Anvil-MOPD is a 9B student that consolidates heterogeneous spatial knowledge through distillation from specialist teachers. Semantic-first-fault routing targets teacher supervision to the student's earliest decisive failure, while stage normalization controls the loss scale across native outputs of different lengths. We construct 5.8M source-grounded records spanning 160K images, reserving 580K spatial records for held-out evaluation and using the remaining 5.22M records for training. On average across seven public benchmarks, Anvil-MOPD outperforms Qwen3.5-9B and RynnBrain-8B by 9.29 and 11.03 percentage points, respectively, while reaching 80.67% on VABench-Point. Controlled studies support targeted coverage, selective transfer, and feedback-guided repair as complementary framework components.
blocks.zh: 健美的空间智能需要的不仅仅是视觉识别:模型必须使实体定位,其关系的理由,并以与行动相关的形式来表达这种知识. 然而,联合培训可以将不同阶段所需的知识混为一谈,因为监督分散于不相容的几何和语义产出。 我们引入了Anvil, 用于数据生成、培训和建立包含的空间情报基准的统一框架。 (1)Anvil-Gen是一款多变的数据飞轮,结合了形式特异生成,跨相相容性验证,以及11个地-关系-行为形式的故障驱动回想. (2) Anvil-Ben为学习不同空间能力提供场地相通性监督,并进行现场相通性评估,区分阶段能力与出错传播。 (3) Anvil-MOPD是一名9B学生,通过专家教师的分馏来整合不同的空间知识. 语义-第一故障通路针对教师监督,以达到学生最早的决定性失败,而阶段正常化则控制不同长度的本土产出的损失规模. 我们建造了5.8M源源头记录,覆盖了160K图像,保留了580K空间记录用于暂停评价,并利用了剩余的5.22M记录用于培训。 在7个公共基准中,Anvil-MOPD的成绩分别比Quen3.5-9B和RynnBrain-8B分别高出9.29和11.03个百分点,而VA Bench-Point则达到80.67%. 受控制的研究支持有的放矢的覆盖、有选择的转移和反馈指导的修复,作为补充框架的组成部分。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Embodied spatial intelligence requires more than visual recognition: a model must localize entities, reason about relations, and identify possible interactions ( Yuan et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026c ) .
Recognizing a coffee machine, for example, does not determine where a cup can be placed beside it. Learning these capabilities requires supervision that connects visual observations to precise, action-relevant spatial judgments.
Web images, reconstructed scenes, and simulated environments offer complementary sources, but differ in their coverage and available geometry ( Song et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Zhi et al., 2025 ) . Scaling embodied spatial intelligence therefore requires both broader supervision and a way to consolidate the knowledge expressed in different output forms.
blocks.zh:
健美的空间智能需要的不仅仅是视觉识别:一个模型必须使实体本地化,关系的原因,并找出可能的相互作用(袁等人,2025年;周等人,2025年;李等人,2026年c).
例如,识别咖啡机并不能确定一个杯子可以放在旁边。 学习这些能力需要监督,将视觉观测与精确的、与行动有关的空间判断联系起来。
网络图像,重建的场景,以及模拟环境提供了互补的源头,但其覆盖范围和可用的几何学不同(Song等人,2024年;Chen等人,2024年;Zhi等人,2025年)。 因此,扩大包含的空间情报既需要更广泛的监督,也需要综合以不同产出形式表达的知识。

blocks.en:
Recent data-driven approaches have advanced spatial grounding and reasoning through synthetic supervision, geometric reconstruction, and capability-diverse training ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Cai et al., 2026 ) .
Broader multimodal and embodied training also demonstrated the
value of integrating diverse visual experience and tasks ( Tong et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026c ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Tan et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026c ) .
These studies support scaling spatial supervision, although gains vary across capabilities and transfer settings ( Cai et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026c ) .
Diagnostic benchmarks also revealed differences that aggregate
scores can obscure ( Du et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026e ) . Building on these advances, we investigate a data-centered question:

blocks.en:
We introduce Anvil , which connects a spatial data flywheel and model training through knowledge recirculation (Figure 1 ): Anvil-Gen operates as a heterogeneous data flywheel, where form-specific generation produces spatial supervision, cross-stage verification identifies inconsistencies, and failure feedback guides targeted data regeneration and collection.
A shared Ground–Relation–Act interface connects 11 native output forms through common entities and explicit dependencies, allowing the same capabilities to be specified across generation, learning, and evaluation. Anvil-Ben organizes the aligned supervision into Anvil-Train for learning and Anvil-Eval for held-out assessment through native-output and scene-linked tasks. Anvil-MOPD integrates knowledge from specialists trained on this supervision through multi-teacher distillation, building on on-policy
knowledge transfer ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Ma et al., 2026a ; Gao et al., 2026 ) .
Semantic-first-fault routing directs teacher supervision to the earliest decisive student error, while stage normalization
controls the loss scale across output lengths.
Validated records can refresh specialists, while the distilled generalist
returns verification signals to the data flywheel. Our contributions are threefold:

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Spatial intelligence research spans relation recognition, geometric estimation, and reasoning about possible interactions. Early evaluations of relational understanding ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Kamath et al., 2023 ) have been complemented by image-based, multi-view, and video-based
benchmarks ( Tong et al., 2024 ; Du et al., 2024 ; Fu et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025b ) , with further emphasis on transformations, planning, and spatial-functional reasoning ( Zhang et al., 2026e ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026c ) . Training has likewise moved beyond image–text pairs toward supervision derived from geometry and robot experience ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Cheng et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) , including precise, interaction-relevant grounding ( Yuan et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ) .
Procedural geometry and executable representations broaden the available targets ( Assouel et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026a ) , while program execution and trajectory consistency help check automatically generated annotations ( Zhi et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2024 ; Blank et al., 2026 ) .
This expanding coverage raises a broader evaluation question: when does success on a particular spatial task indicate competence that transfers to other tasks?
blocks.zh:
空间情报研究涉及关系识别、几何估计和可能的相互作用推理。 对关系理解的早期评价(Liu等人,2023年;Kamath等人,2023年)得到了基于图像、多视图和视频的补充
基准(Tong等人,2001年) 2024年;Du等人,2024年;Fu等人,2024年;Yang等人,2025年b),进一步强调转变,规划和空间功能推理(Zhang等人,2026年e; Wu等人,2025年;张等人,2026年b;张等人,2026年c). 同样,培训也超越了图像的文本对,转向了从几何学和机器人经验中产生的监督(Chen等人,2024年;Cheng等人,2024年;Chen等人,2025年),包括精确的、与互动有关的地面(Yuan等人,2025年;Zhou等人,2025年)。
程序几何学和可执行表述拓宽了现有目标(Assouel等人,2026年;Liu等人,2026年a),而程序执行和轨迹一致性帮助检查自动生成的说明(Zhi等人,2025年;Hu等人,2024年;Blank等人,2026年).
这种扩大的覆盖范围提出了一个更广泛的评价问题:在特定空间任务上取得成功何时表明将权限转移到其他任务?

blocks.en:
Large-scale pretraining has connected visual–linguistic knowledge to embodied reasoning and robot control ( Driess et al., 2023 ; Zitkovich et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2025 ) . Autoregressive and diffusion policies provide alternative action interfaces, with generalist policies supporting adaptation across robot platforms ( Octo Model Team et al., 2024 ) .
In parallel, spatially focused models develop geometric and spatiotemporal understanding ( Cai et al., 2026 ; Tan et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026c ) , using structured scene representations, targeted supervision, or progressive curricula ( Ju et al., 2026 ; Ray et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026b ) . Reasoning–action models increasingly connect these capabilities to action prediction ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026c ) . The challenge is to turn diverse training signals into generalizable capabilities, rather than a collection of task-specific skills.
blocks.zh:
大规模的预训将视觉-语言知识与体现推理和机器人控制联系起来(Driess等人,2023年;Zitkovich等人,2023年;Kim等人,2025年)。 自动递减和传播政策提供了替代行动界面,通用政策支持机器人平台的适应(Octo Model Team等人,2024年).
与此同时,以空间为重点的模型利用结构化场景展示、定向监督或渐进式课程,发展几何和瞬间理解(Cai等人,2026年;Tan等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年c) (Ju等人,2026年;Ray等人,2025年;Li等人,2026年b). 理性-行动模型日益将这些能力与行动预测联系起来(Liu等人,2025年;Liu等人,2026年c)。 挑战在于将各种培训信号转化为可通用的能力,而不是收集具体任务的技能。

blocks.en:
Distillation transfers teacher knowledge through output distributions or generated sequences ( Hinton et al., 2015 ; Kim & Rush, 2016 ) ; subsequent language-model methods address student behavior through reverse-KL and on-policy learning ( Gu et al., 2024 ; Agarwal et al., 2024 ) .
Multi-teacher extensions introduce choices about both knowledge sources and supervision budgets ( Ma et al., 2026a ; Gao et al., 2026 ) .
Selection can operate over examples and tasks through rationale consolidation, answer verification, or privileged
context ( Jin et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026b ) , or within trajectories through discrepancy-triggered intervention and failed-prefix recovery ( Koo et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) .
Related approaches target informative tokens ( Liu et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026a ) ,
cross-view representations ( Nguyen et al., 2026 ) , and intermediate reasoning steps ( Lightman et al., 2024 ) , while iterative bootstrapping reuses answer-checked model outputs for further training ( Zelikman et al., 2022 ) .
Selective supervision thus raises a question of reliability: how can useful teacher knowledge be retained without also reinforcing its errors?
blocks.zh:
通过输出分布或生成序列(Hinton等人,2015年;Kim & Rush,2016年);后续语言模型方法通过反向-KL及政策学习解决学生行为(Gu等人,2024年;Agarwal等人,2024年).
多教师扩展引入了知识来源和监督预算的选择(Ma等人,2026a;Gao等人,2026).
通过合并理由、回答核查或特权,选择可以对实例和任务进行操作。
环境(Jin等人,2026年;He等人,2026年;Ma等人,2026年b),或通过差异触发干预和故障前缀恢复在轨(Koo等人,2025年;Xu等人,2026年)。
相关办法针对信息符号(Liu等人,2026b;Li等人,2026a) , (中文).
交叉观点表述 (Nguyen等人,2026年),以及中间推理步骤(Lightman等人,2024年),同时迭接靴子重新使用经复验的模型输出供进一步训练(Zelikman等人,2022年).
因此,选择性监督引起一个可靠性问题:如何保留有用的教师知识而不强化其错误?

blocks.en: To address these gaps, Anvil treats supervision reliability and knowledge transfer as coupled problems. Scene-aligned annotations support specialist-to-generalist distillation and held-out evaluation through knowledge recirculation; the resulting student can then assist further data verification. The knowledge recirculation mechanism links data refinement to model learning so that their effects on spatial competence can be studied together.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这些差距,Anvil将监督的可靠性和知识转让视为连带问题。 场景对称说明支持专家对通论的蒸馏和通过知识循环进行搁置评价;随后产生的学生可以协助进一步的数据验证. 知识循环机制将数据完善与模型学习联系起来,以便它们对于空间能力的影响能够一起研究.

blocks.en: 3 Anvil: Learning through Knowledge Recirculation
blocks.zh: 3 Anvil:通过知识循环学习

blocks.en: Anvil connects spatial data production and model learning through knowledge recirculation (Figure 1 ). Shared entities and task dependencies align heterogeneous targets within a scene. These references support cross-form verification and localized repair in Anvil-Gen , then identify the specialist and response span requiring correction during distillation. The resulting generalist assists subsequent verification, while evidence-backed checks retain acceptance authority and Anvil-Ben reserves separate targets for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 安维尔通过知识循环将空间数据制作和模型学习联系起来(图1). 共同的实体和任务依赖关系使一个场景中的各种目标一致。 这些参考文献支持在Anvil-Gen进行跨形式核查和局部修复,然后确定在蒸馏过程中需要改正的专家和反应周期。 由此产生的通论者协助后续核查,而证据支持的检查保留接受权,安维尔-本则保留单独的评价目标.

blocks.en: 3.2 Generation, Verification, and Feedback
blocks.zh: 3.2 生成、核查和反馈

blocks.en:
Native targets are obtained through source-annotation conversion or

Normalizing the repair comparison by allocated GPU time gives 39.38 39.38 correct records per GPU-hour for named feedback and 3.98 3.98 for generic retry, a 9.90 × 9.90\times advantage. We first test whether independently learned Ground and Relation outputs compose under a shared interface. On 282 282 images from 50 50 held-out physical scenes, linked supervision reaches 69.86 % 69.86\% strict
Ground–Relation success, substantially exceeding the atomic mixture at matched updates (Figure 5 a). To separate missing delimiters from errors in the predicted content, we close stage tags in the saved responses without changing their JSON outputs. This raises the atomic mixture to 44.68 % 44.68\% while leaving linked performance unchanged.
The remaining gap indicates that output syntax is only part of the
composition problem. A downstream stage must also receive the correct
entities and geometry from its predecessor. Scene-linked supervision
trains this dependency explicitly, making intermediate outputs useful
inputs to subsequent reasoning rather than merely separately correct answers.

地面-关系成功,在相应的更新中大大超过原子混合物(图5a)。 为了将缺失的分隔符与预测内容的错误区分开来,我们在保存的响应中关闭阶段标记,而不改变其JSON输出. 这使得原子混合物升至44.68% 44.68%,而链接性能不变.
剩余差距表明,产出语法只是
组成问题。 下游阶段也必须得到正确的
实体和几何学。 现场监督
明确训练这种依赖性,使中间产出有用
输入随后的推理,而不仅仅是单独的正确答案。

blocks.en:
We next examine dependence on the evidence supplied to these stages.
With questions and targets fixed, blank images reduce the
source-filtered model’s accuracy on the 1,463-example grounding
panel from 57.35% to 7.66%. Cross-scene shuffling also degrades grounding, while BLINK-depth approaches chance (Figure 5 b). Keeping images and depth targets fixed but shifting upstream boxes reduces the Relation specialist’s accuracy by 10.64 10.64 points (Table 18 ). In particular, errors in Ground can alter the context available to Relation even when the scene image remains fixed. These interventions establish sensitivity to both visual content and consumed geometry, motivating joint evaluation of stage accuracy and linked success.

blocks.en:
We extend the evaluation to action order under state constraints.
From 506 506 ALFRED trajectories ( Shridhar et al., 2020 ) across 92 92 scenes, we construct 1,012 1{,}012 balanced judgments, pairing each valid plan with an invalid permutation of the same actions. This fixes vocabulary and length, so action occurrence alone cannot distinguish the labels. Given the initial image, complete Boolean state, goal, and action rules, the Action specialist improves over the base by 6.72 6.72 points (Figure 5 c). Class-wise results remain uneven: accuracy is 89.53 % 89.53\% on invalid plans but only 55.53 % 55.53\% on valid ones (Table 19 ). The improvement mainly comes from recognizing more valid plans, although many feasible sequences are still rejected.

从506 506 ALFRED轨迹(Shridhar et al., 2020)跨越92 92场场景,我们构建了1,012 1{,}012 平衡的判断,将每个有效的计划与相同的动作的无效排列对齐. 这可以固定词汇和长度,因此单是动作发生无法区分标签. 鉴于最初的图像,完整的布尔状态,目标,和行动规则,行动专家比基数提高了6.726.72分(图5c). 分类结果仍然不均衡:无效计划的准确度为89.53%89.53%,有效计划的准确度仅为55.53%55.53%(表19)。 改进主要来自于承认更有效的计划,尽管许多可行的序列仍然被拒绝.

blocks.en:
The experiments suggest that spatial learning depends on how supervision
is organized, not only how much is available. Coverage controls favor task-relevant additions with replay; routing controls favor localized specialist correction; and repair controls show the value of actionable failure feedback. Source-based construction complements these mechanisms by reusing
available geometric evidence. Beyond aggregate benchmark gains, the composition, input, and action-order controls test whether predictions remain useful when later decisions depend on their content. These findings motivate scaling spatial supervision through capability coverage, selective correction, and explicit task dependencies.
blocks.zh:
实验表明,空间学习取决于如何监督
不仅可以提供多少资金,而且可以提供多少资金。 覆盖控制有利于与任务相关的添加,并进行重播;路由控制有利于本地化的专家校正;修复控制显示可操作故障反馈值. 基于源的构造通过再利用来补充这些机制
可用的几何证据。 除了总的基准收益之外,组成、投入和行动顺序控制还检验在以后的决定取决于其内容时预测是否仍然有用。 这些结论促使通过能力覆盖、选择性纠正和明确的任务依赖来扩大空间监督。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented Anvil , which connects spatial data generation, evaluation,
and multi-teacher learning through knowledge recirculation. Shared scene references support cross-form verification, guide selective specialist transfer, and govern the acceptance of returned supervision. The final model improves the seven-benchmark mean by 9.29 points over its base; controlled studies support targeted coverage, selective transfer, and feedback-driven repair. Together, these findings support jointly designing reliable supervision and knowledge consolidation for embodied spatial intelligence.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍了Anvil,它连接了空间数据生成,评估,
和多教师通过知识循环学习。 共享场景参考支持跨形式验证,引导选择性专家转移,规范接受回归监管. 最终模型改进了7个基准平均值,比基数高9.29分;受控研究支持目标覆盖,选择性转移,以及反馈驱动修复. 这些调查结果共同支持为包含的空间情报共同设计可靠的监督和知识整合。

blocks.en:
The current framework organizes supervision through eleven
Ground–Relation–Act forms with explicit entities and dependencies.
Open-world environments introduce spatial concepts and interaction
requirements beyond this inventory. Extensible interfaces could incorporate
new relations, affordances, and temporal dependencies while retaining a
common basis for generation, verification, and learning. The challenge is
to expand this vocabulary without losing the scene evidence supporting
each target.

blocks.en:
Anvil studies knowledge transfer within specified spatial tasks and
stage dependencies. Future work could extend specialist-to-generalist
learning to unfamiliar combinations of goals, environments, and embodiments.
The question is whether grounding, relational reasoning, and action
knowledge can compose into reusable spatial expertise, supporting new
tasks with less task-specific supervision.

blocks.en:
The present framework draws on curated sources and explicit verification
signals. Spatial uncertainty and encountered failures could guide what an
agent observes and attempts next, with physical interaction outcomes
grounding the returned supervision. Connecting experience collection to
specialist refinement and continued generalist learning remains a future
direction: stronger spatial competence should support both better decisions
and more informative data acquisition.
